svg.text: A kept idea loses only its theme affiliation. The goals
cannot be kept, so confirming takes them.
A goal requires a theme, so keeping one is not a legal
outcome: where the theme has goals the gesture is
approve-or-abandon. An idea may stay behind
theme-less, so that cascade is the real choice and it
starts off. An archived descendant is counted like a live
The request carries the cascades the user confirmed,
and nothing else goes: an idea left out stays, theme-less.
What happens below a deleted goal or idea is that
entity's own rule, applied where the deletion reaches it.
